### [Introducing Claude Sonnet 5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5)

**Anthropic** · 2026-08-10

Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5, an agentic AI model that approaches Opus 4.8 performance levels at a lower cost across coding, reasoning, and tool-use tasks.

- Priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens via the Claude API (`claude-sonnet-5`).
- Outperforms Sonnet 4.6 and offers adjustable effort levels to match Opus 4.8 on select BrowseComp and OSWorld-Verified benchmarks.
- Demonstrates autonomous multi-step execution, unprompted self-verification, self-debugging, and tool use across web browsers and terminals.
- Safety assessments indicate lower rates of undesirable behaviors than Sonnet 4.6 and significantly lower cybersecurity task capability compared to Opus models.

**Why it matters:** It provides near-top-tier agentic and software engineering capabilities at a substantially reduced cost-performance ratio compared to larger Opus-class models.

### [Introducing Muse Glimmer](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/10/introducing-muse-glimmer/#atom-everything)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-10

Meta has released Muse Glimmer, a 30B open-weights vision-language model available under an Apache 2.0 license.

- Optimized for end-to-end agentic tasks, tool use, and multi-step reasoning evaluated on benchmarks like DeepSearch QA, MCP-Atlas, ቲ-Bench, and SWE-Bench.
- Features multimodal vision capabilities alongside extended multi-turn reasoning and function calling schemas.
- Released under an Apache 2.0 license and fits on local machines with 32 GB or more of RAM (with an 18.16 GB quantized footprint in LM Studio).

**Why it matters:** It provides a permissively licensed, open-weights 30B local model capable of complex coding agent tasks and image analysis on standard developer hardware.
